raw_response: AI visibility for local businesses refers to how often and how favorably a business appears in responses generated by AI search tools, chatbots, and answer engines (such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude) when users search for local products, services, or recommendations. Unlike traditional search engine optimization (SEO) which focuses on ranking blue links on a search engine results page, AI visibility measures whether an AI assistant mentions, recommends, or cites the business when answering conversational queries like "best plumber near me" or "where can I get a good coffee in downtown". It depends heavily on clear business facts, structured data schema, positive customer reviews, and consistent directory citations across the web.
notes: Level 1 raw response captured for Gemini P01.
